maxLength.source: current configuration rag.retrieval.cross-encoder.max-length (snapshots do not record it)

rank.source: snapshot results rank (null: no matching chunk in the window)

matchedChunkId.source: snapshot results matchedChunkId (null: no matching chunk in the window)

retrievalStrategy.source: snapshot results retrievalStrategy (null: retrieval error, or stored before the field)

fallbackReason.source: trace rerank fallbackReason (null: not a fallback)

scoresNotRecorded.source: trace rerank scoresNotRecorded (null: every rerank input carries its position and score, or not reranked)

queryTokens.rule: tokens of the question text bounded to 20,000 characters, tokenized alone by the loaded cross-encoder tokenizer

heldByStoredChunk.source: sec_filing_chunks at report time: chunks of the phrase's accession and section whose text contains the phrase (RetrievalEvaluationService.matches)

chunkTokens.rule: tokens of the stored chunk text bounded to 20,000 characters, tokenized alone by the loaded cross-encoder tokenizer

windowLength.rule: W = max-length (from the current configuration, not recorded in the snapshot) - 3 - the query tokens kept against the whole chunk, longest first (CrossEncoderPairAssembler.windowLength)

windowStarts.rule: start token of each row under the snapshot's rerankerScoring: head one row at 0; max-window CrossEncoderPairAssembler.windowStarts(chunk tokens, W, overlap, max-windows); these are the rows the recorded scoring scores for this chunk beside this question only when the chunk is a rerank input of a RERANKED trace (rerankInput observed true); for reranking off, a fallback, a question without a trace, or a chunk outside the rerank input they are the rows the recorded scoring would score, not rows that were scored

characterSpan.rule: occurrence of the normalised phrase in the normalised chunk text (whitespace runs collapsed, trimmed, lower-cased), mapped to UTF-16 offsets of the stored text, end exclusive

tokenSpan.rule: tokens of the whole-chunk tokenization whose character span overlaps the occurrence, end exclusive

head.rule: wholly: token span end <= W; partly: start < W < end; not: start >= W

windowsHoldingWholly.rule: 1-based rows whose tokens [start, start + min(W, chunk tokens)) contain the whole token span (empty: no row holds it wholly); these are the rows the recorded scoring scores for this chunk beside this question only when the chunk is a rerank input of a RERANKED trace (rerankInput observed true); for reranking off, a fallback, a question without a trace, or a chunk outside the rerank input they are the rows the recorded scoring would score, not rows that were scored

fusedPosition.source: trace fused (null: not in the fused list)
